purpose: Repo-local OS Abyss artifact bundle input for generated/seed_route_map.min.json.

consumer_contract.consumer_expectation: Seed consumers select a dionysus_seed_route_readmodel_bundle from the registry latest read-model only after ABI verification, durable evidence promotion, materialized subject-store verification, source/trust-root matching, seed route validation, and seed-surface validation pass; the generated route map remains navigation, not seed canon or owner-repo landing proof.

consumer_command: abyss-machine artifacts evidence-promote BUNDLE_DIR --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --lifecycle-state release-ready --consumer-ref Dionysus:seed-route-readmodel --evidence-ref BUNDLE_DIR/artifact.verify.json --source-repo Dionysus --source-ref docs/codex/artifact-bundles/manifests/seed_route_readmodel.bundle.json --producer Dionysus-seed-route-readmodel-builder --trust-root-mode host_managed --json

abyss-machine artifacts materialize-subjects BUNDLE_DIR --store-root SUBJECT_STORE_ROOT --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --manifest docs/codex/artifact-bundles/manifests/seed_route_readmodel.bundle.json --consumer-intent agent --source-repo Dionysus --trust-root-mode host_managed --json

abyss-machine artifacts trust-gate --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --artifact-class dionysus_seed_route_readmodel_bundle --consumer-intent agent --source-repo Dionysus --trust-root-mode host_managed --subject-digest SUBJECT_DIGEST --json

abyss-machine artifacts registry-latest --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --artifact-class dionysus_seed_route_readmodel_bundle --consumer-intent agent --source-repo Dionysus --trust-root-mode host_managed --json
